title: Approving a fee refund

steps.title: Search for the customer and open the account
Check the amount against the refund authority limit
Post the refund to the account
Leave a note on the account

decisions: If the customer has had a fee refund in the last 12 months, decline politely unless the fee was the bank's mistake; otherwise, if the eligibility checks pass, refund.
Agents approve refunds up to M$50; up to M$250 goes to a team lead; above M$250 goes to the Complaints team.
If the customer asks for compensation on top of the refund, note it and pass it to Complaints.
warnings: Refund only to the account the fee was taken from; crediting a different account is a payment, not a refund, and gets flagged.
openQuestions: Whether the unpaid item fee counts toward the customer's yearly goodwill allowance: Lorna will check with the Product team.
